Native opt-in AffineMidpointOpaque implementation is now in the reserved source paths, uncommitted. Four midpoint children share one 4x4 block, preserving final opaque RGB semantics; no scientific mesh subdivision. Picks resolve native children back to packet faces and existing original barycentrics/IDs. Morphs update midpoint positions/normals, color changes update final texels/constant UVs, actual child face and byte counts are reported, and expanded geometry is budgeted before allocation.

Qualified source is retained at /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/affine-21/native-source, native-candidate.patch, findings.json and sha256.json. Native base 887a5ce4a88e3f219dad99bce46aaf6853126d1d. Six new actual-atlas/UV independent regressions pass; full JavaFX suite 32, shared surface JVM 128 and JS 128 pass. Explicit native 1,200 child-pick dispatch checks across chunks pass on JavaFX 21.0.5 and on application 24.0.1 using the compatibility module; no visible Stage or OS ray-pick claim. Initial ordinary build exposed existing Intaglio pin mismatch, now separately lodged bd-01M249KVV594XXRVFC0670RMAT. These tests use exact historical qualified Intaglio 55658abfbbfed0c9a36ab612b38bd8f0677bc158 via explicit override. A regression in my first overly broad texture-size admission guard was caught by the existing approximation test and corrected to preserve its old boundary; final 288 tests pass.

The two-class exact JavaFX 24.0.1 ES2 no-mipmap/centroid JAR is now tested through --patch-module=javafx.graphics=... with asserted material and shader origins. Public MSAA gray-ramp RMS remains 0.329018/0.410830/0.391206 at 8,192/32,768/131,072 faces. This is a workable maintained compatibility-component mechanism, not production or cross-platform adoption; it still affects the process-wide colour-map policy.

New cheaper path: for each original face, try all three cyclic color anchors. If q+r-p is in [0,255]^3, one triangle with affine texture continuation suffices. Exact exported unlit beta cortex contains 549,018 faces; ALL qualify for one triangle, only 1,548 require rotating the UV/color anchor, zero fallback faces. Same runtime/value/geometry source retained in dump/ with 12 native cases passing. Thus fourfold geometry is avoidable in that colour state. This is arithmetic feasibility only; adaptive encoding and coherent changes of split/anchor layouts are not implemented. Keep the four-child implementation as the general safe fallback/reference. Native GPU edge-specific color tests, atlas permutation, ray picking, lighting/device/obliquity sweeps, adaptive update handling, dense latency/memory and production runtime admission remain open. No consumer pin changed.
